data.text:
Jayeshkumar Surendra Pokharna And 2 ... vs The State Of
Maharashtra Thr. P.S.O., ... on 26 April, 2024
Author: Vinay Joshi 
Bench: Vinay Joshi
 1 
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Nagpur Bench : Nagpur
 Criminal Application (Apl) No.678/2024
 (Jayeshkumar Surendra Pokharna and others Vs. State of Mahar
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 Office Notes, Office Memoranda of Coram, C
 appearances, Court's orders of directions
 and Registrar's orders 
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 Mr. S.A. Mohta, Counsel for the applicants. 
 Coram: Vinay Joshi And Mrs.Vrushali V. Joshi, 
Dated : 26.4.2024. 
Heard. 
2. This is an application seeking to quash chargesheet arising out of Crime No.0201/2023 registered
by non-applicant No.1 for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 read with
Section 34 of Indian Penal Code and Sections 26(2)(i), 27(3)(e), 30(2)
(a) and 59 of Food Safety and Standard Act. 
3. Issue notice to the non-applicants returnable after eight weeks.
4.  Mr. A.M. Chutke, learned A.P.P. waives notice for non-applicant No.1.
5. In the meantime, the trial Court shall not proceed till the next date of hearing. 
(MRS.VRUSHALI V.JOSHI, J.) (VINAY JOSHI, J.) Tambaskar. 
Signed by: MR. N.V. TAMBASKAR Designation: PA To Honourable Judge Date: 26/04/2024 14:59:44 Jayeshkumar Surendra Pokharna And 2 ... vs The State Of Maharashtra Thr. P.S.O., ... on 26 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153751810/
